shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git ls-files | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html; ls __agent_eval__; sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i -C 3 "gravity-ui/table|data grid|Table" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,120p
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination; sed -n 150,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/Table build/esm/components/Table/hoc 2>/dev/null; find build/esm/components/Table build/esm/components/Pagination -name "*.d.ts" | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Table/Table.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts Pagination/Pagination.d.ts Pagination/types.d.ts Table/hoc/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "theme\|size" components/Label/Label.d.ts | head; grep -rn "export.*configure\|Lang" utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "configure\|Table\|Pagination\|Flex\|Label\|Text\b" index.d.ts components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; grep -n "color" components/Text/Text.d.ts components/text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls components/layout/Flex 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 1,8p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; grep -c "g-spacing-6" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/DataTable.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("const EnhancedTable = withTableSelection<Employee>(withTableSorting<Employee>(Table));",
"const EnhancedTable = withTableSelection<Employee, WithTableSortingProps>(withTableSorting<Employee>(Table));")
s=s.replace("import type {LabelProps, TableColumnConfig, TableSortState} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';",
"import type {LabelProps, TableColumnConfig, TableSortState, WithTableSortingProps} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
